data.notes: December 2026 is confirmed mostly as a concert-heavy month around Seoul, with arena Korean-pop legacy shows, international Live Nation bookings, and a strong cluster of Hongdae/Mapo live-house dates rather than announced club residencies.

events.title: Khalid: It's Always Summer Somewhere Tour
events.summary: Khalid headlines KINTEX Hall 10 in the Seoul metro area on his It's Always Summer Somewhere Tour. Live Nation Korea lists the December 5 date with Khalid as headliner.

events.title: wave to earth world tour 2026 — the pieces tour @ Seoul
events.summary: wave to earth play a three-night hometown Seoul run at Korea University's Hwajung Gymnasium. The dates are confirmed for December 18–20 after an added show expanded the run.

events.title: 2026 RAIN CONCERT [THE SMOKE]
events.summary: Rain returns to Olympic Hall for two Seoul shows billed as THE SMOKE. The confirmed performances are December 5 at 6:00 PM and December 6 at 5:00 PM.

events.title: FKJ: Tyber Tour
events.summary: FKJ brings the Tyber Tour to KINTEX Hall 10 in the Seoul metro area. The Live Nation listing confirms FKJ for December 6.

events.title: SLOWDIVE Live 2026 in Seoul
events.summary: Slowdive return to Seoul for a Live Nation Korea-promoted show at KBS Arena. The confirmed date is December 8, with Slowdive listed as headliner.

events.title: Malcolm Todd: Do That Again Tour in Seoul
events.summary: Malcolm Todd brings his Do That Again Tour to Myung Hwa Live Hall for his first confirmed Seoul headline date. The listing names Malcolm Todd and Hobart on the bill.

events.title: Lee Seung-chul: THE VOICE — 40th Anniversary Tour [Seoul]
events.summary: Korean pop-rock and ballad figure Lee Seung-chul plays three Seoul dates at KSPO Dome as part of his 40th-anniversary tour. The run is confirmed for December 4–6 at Olympic Park.

events.title: WHO ASKED? TOUR: DOMi & JD BECK Live [Seoul]
events.summary: DOMi & JD BECK bring their WHO ASKED? tour to Gonggam Center in Seoul. The KOPIS-backed listing confirms the December 12 show at 7:00 PM.

events.title: KANA-BOON: Critical Hit Parade — Asian Adventure
events.summary: Osaka band KANA-BOON plays YES24 Live Hall on the Critical Hit Parade — Asian Adventure tour. The Seoul date is confirmed for December 5 at 6:00 PM KST.

events.title: Jane Remover: Live Exhibit in Seoul
events.summary: Jane Remover plays a Seoul Live Exhibit date at Musinsa Garage. The event is confirmed for December 11 at 8:00 PM and ticketed through YES24.

events.title: Benny Sings Live in Seoul
events.summary: Benny Sings plays a standing-room Seoul show at Musinsa Garage in Hongdae. The show is billed as Benny Sings Live in Seoul and promoted by Gimbab Records.

events.title: Mass Of The Fermenting Dregs World Tour: Iwaou with Dabda [Seoul]
events.summary: Japanese alternative band Mass Of The Fermenting Dregs stop in Seoul with Korean band Dabda at KT&G Sangsangmadang Live Hall. This is a strong Mapo live-house pick for guitar-driven underground travelers.

events.title: WHO ASKED? TOUR, DOMi & JD BECK Live in Seoul
events.summary: The French-American keys-and-drums duo bring their jazz, hip-hop and R&B-rooted WHO ASKED? tour to a Seoul hall show, a strong genre crossover booking outside the arena circuit.

events.title: ZAZEN BOYS MATSURI SESSION [Seoul]
events.summary: ZAZEN BOYS play a Matsuri Session show at Musinsa Garage in Hongdae. The event is confirmed for December 6 at 5:00 PM.

events.title: APF Concerts Presents: Sunny Day Service Tour in Seoul
events.summary: Japanese indie-pop veterans Sunny Day Service play Musinsa Garage in Hongdae through APF Concerts. The confirmed lineup lists Harushige Maruyama, Keiichi Sokabe, and Takashi Tanaka.

events.title: Khaki ONE-MAN Live in Seoul
events.summary: Khaki plays a one-man Seoul show at KT&G Sangsangmadang Live Hall in Mapo. The event is listed with Master Plan Music Group as organiser and NOL as ticketing outlet.

events.title: Penthouse ONE MAN LIVE TOUR Neon Garden in Seoul
events.summary: Penthouse bring the Neon Garden one-man live tour to YES24 Live Hall. The Seoul concert is confirmed for December 19 at 7:00 PM.

events.title: RETRORIRON LIVE [Seoul Encore]
events.summary: Japanese band RETRORIRON play an encore Seoul date at NOL Theater Hapjeong. The performance is confirmed for December 5 at 6:00 PM.
